how_to_find: Open your fork on GitHub. Look at the date of the newest commit by the upstream author on the main branch. Match it to the dates below. Commits by github-actions[bot] only regenerate your index and do not count. The newest upstream commit seen when this wizard was released is 70371e0, dated 2026-08-05. No git tags or releases were visible to this wizard (VERIFY). The package.json version is 1.0.0 and does not change with each version below.

versions.title: Claude publishing skill template
versions.summary: VERIFY: This entry comes from commit dates on 2026-08-05, not from tags. The repository now holds a skill file that you copy into Claude. The newest commit seen is 70371e0.

changes.text: claude-skill/SKILL.md, a template skill that lets Claude publish documents for you (commit 9a5580b).
Setup step 6 in the README points to the prepared skill file (commit 70371e0).

upgrade_steps.title: Sync your fork
upgrade_steps.text: Open your fork on GitHub. Click Sync fork, then Update branch. If you already made your own SKILL.md copy, compare it with the new claude-skill/SKILL.md and copy over any change you want.

versions.title: First release
versions.summary: VERIFY: This entry comes from commit dates on 2026-07-24, not from tags. It covers the first commit and all work that day, ending with commit 251ebfa.

changes.text: Express server with optional per-document password protection that fails closed (commit 2e92f69).
Empty protected.json manifest, so all documents are open by default (commit 9fac9d4).
Index generator with brand settings, groups and Protected badges, plus a GitHub Action that rebuilds the index (commits ba48354, aaa16ef).
Site settings moved into site.config.json so that updates never conflict (commits 03e833b, 3689d0e).
README sections on getting updates and on enabling Actions on your fork, and MAINTAINING.md with the file ownership rules (commits a4bff43, 3fef5bd, 251ebfa).
